title: Longhorn PHP 2025 - Call For Papers
content:
Longhorn PHP returns for 2025! Held in Austin, TX, the conference will run from October 23-25, with a tutorial day on Thursday, followed by two main conference days. We are excited to bring PHP developers from all backgrounds together again for three days of fun and education. While the CFP is open, we also have our Blind Bird tickets available for sale.We are currently accepting talk and tutorial submissions.

Register today!

Follow us on signup for emails at to get notified with important conference updates.Mastodonlonghornphp.com
author: PHP.net news & announcements
